verdict.rationale: Zulip documents its own framework for interactive bots that react to messages, which you can deploy with the Zulip Botserver. That provides the core mechanism of a bot participating in conversations. But no AI agent ships in the evidence, so a user would have to write and host a custom bot to get one. missing for 10: a first-party or ready-made AI/LLM agent bot, documented mention-triggered responses, documentation of adding a bot as a channel member, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can add an AI agent as a member of a channel that participates in conversations when mentioned

citations.quote: Zulip’s API has a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages in Zulip. You can write and run a custom bot, or run an existing Zulip bot.
deploying it on a server using the Zulip Botserver
